# `path` standard library

The `path` module provides pure lexical path manipulation with zero filesystem or `libc`
dependencies. It uses compile-time target inspection (`#! os`) to select native
Windows vs. POSIX separators and drive-prefix semantics, while also exposing explicit
`posix_*` and `win_*` functions for cross-platform tooling.

```{.dva .run}
#use io
#use path

p = path::normalize("/usr/local/../bin/./edva")
io::out $ p
io::out $ path::dirname(p)
io::out $ path::basename(p)
```

## Constants and Function catalog

| Category | Symbol / Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Constants** | `path::SEP` / `path::SEP_STR` | `Int` / `String` | Native path separator (`'/'` or `'\\'`) |
| | `path::LIST_SEP` / `path::LIST_SEP_STR` | `Int` / `String` | Native `$PATH` list separator (`':'` or `';'`) |
| **Predicates** | `path::is_sep(c)` | `Int => <>` | True if byte `c` is a path separator on the target OS |
| | `path::is_abs(p)` / `path::is_rel(p)` | `String => <>` | True if path `p` is absolute / relative |
| | `path::has_ext(p, ext)` | `String, String => <>` | Case-insensitive extension check (with or without leading `.`) |
| **Joining & Normalization** | `path::join(a, b)` | `String, String => String` | Joins two path segments with a single separator |
| | `path::join_all(parts)` | `String{} => String` | Joins an array of path segments |
| | `path::normalize(p)` | `String => String` | Resolves `.` and `..` segments and collapses redundant separators |
| | `path::rel(base, target)` | `String, String => String` | Computes lexical relative path from `base` to `target` |
| **Decomposition** | `path::dirname(p)` / `path::parent(p)` | `String => String` | Directory portion of `p` |
| | `path::basename(p)` | `String => String` | Final path component of `p` |
| | `path::split(p)` | `String => (String, String)` | Returns `(dirname(p), basename(p))` |
| | `path::components(p)` | `String => String{}` | Splits path into logical components |
| | `path::ext(p)` | `String => String` | Extension including leading `.` (e.g. `".dva"`), or `""` |
| | `path::get_ext(p)` | `String => String` | Lowercase extension without leading `.` (e.g. `"dva"`) |
| | `path::stem(p)` | `String => String` | Basename without its final extension |
| | `path::with_ext(p, ext)` | `String, String => String` | Replaces (or removes when `""`) the extension of `p` |
| **Glob Matching** | `path::match_glob(pat, text)` | `String, String => <>` | Wildcard matching supporting `*`, `?`, and `[...]` character classes |
| **Explicit OS Flavors** | `path::posix_*` / `path::win_*` | Various | Explicit POSIX and Windows variants (`join`, `normalize`, `dirname`, `basename`, `is_abs`, `rel`) |
